name: Among Humanity

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Frequency once per day

---
Your talents in shapechanging allow you to pass unseen. When you Change Shape into your humanoid form, you gain the effects of 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise for 1 hour or until you shift back, except it's a polymorph effect rather than an illusion.
